title: Official REGISTRY source list
summary: Line-oriented source membership list, cross-checked against each package manifest before any Official bundle is generated.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: read_registry
operations.notes: No deadline. UTF-8 text; blank or comment-only lines ignored. Split at first #, then exactly five whitespace fields: on|off folder id@version product kind. id@version contains exactly one @. Invalid/missing file raises SystemExit, not a LucError.

operations.name: registry_problems
operations.notes: No deadline. Returns problems for duplicate folders/ids, unlisted folders, missing manifests, mismatched id/version/on/product/kind, missing note and wrong migration gate. Manifest and filesystem parsing exceptions can propagate.

invariants.text: A folder without a REGISTRY line cannot become an Official package.
The builder refuses membership lines that disagree with the package manifest.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.
